Do It or Drink.description: A player performs a quick action; if they refuse or fail, they drink.

Most Likely To.description: All players vote for the person who best fits the prompt. The winner drinks.

Storytelling.description: The prompted player tells a short story; if they skip, they drink.

Challenges.description: Race-style or group-condition prompts. Either the first to complete drinks/gives drinks, or everyone matching a condition drinks.

action_or_drink.client_behavior: Show action text + two buttons: Did it / Drink

group_vote.client_behavior: Show player list for selection; backend tallies votes

story_or_skip.client_behavior: Prompt storytelling; optional voice note; skip equals drink

first_to_act_or_group_condition.client_behavior: Either first-to-tap race or automatic group filter (e.g., everyone wearing black)
